stories.title: Abstimmung vom 27. September – Neutralitätsinitiative wird gemäss Trendrechnung abgelehnt

en.title: September 27 Vote – Neutrality Initiative Rejected According to Trend Calculation
en.summary: Voters appear to be rejecting a proposal to enshrine perpetual armed neutrality in the constitution, according to early voting trends.

stories.title: Genève accepterait de payer pour réduire le trafic transfrontalier, vers un oui à la contraception gratuite

en.title: Geneva Would Accept Paying to Reduce Cross-Border Traffic, Heading Toward Yes on Free Contraception
en.summary: Geneva appears poised to approve spending 39.5 million francs to co-finance cross-border mobility infrastructure and a free contraception initiative, both tracking toward approval in Sunday voting.

stories.title: Abstimmungen live – SRG-Trend: Zweimal Nein zu den beiden Initiativen

en.title: Live Votes – SRG Trend: Two No's on Both Initiatives
en.summary: Voters are deciding on neutrality and nutrition initiatives, with early trends showing rejection of both measures, while cantonal and municipal votes also take place.

stories.title: Abstimmung Kanton Graubünden – Es sieht nach einem Nein aus beim Stimmrechtsalter 16

en.title: Graubünden Vote – Appears to Be a No on Lowering Voting Age to 16
en.summary: The canton of Graubünden is voting again on lowering the voting age to 16, with preliminary results indicating the measure will be rejected.

stories.title: Vers un double non aux initiatives sur la neutralité et l’alimentation, selon les premières tendances SSR

en.title: Towards a double no on neutrality and food initiatives, according to initial SSR trends
en.summary: Early polling data suggests Swiss voters are likely to reject two ballot initiatives, one concerning constitutional neutrality and another on food sovereignty.

stories.title: En Afrique du Sud, deux fusillades tuent au moins 27 personnes dans la nuit

en.title: In South Africa, two shootings kill at least 27 people overnight
en.summary: Armed men opened fire at venues in Johannesburg and near Cape Town, killing at least 27 people in separate incidents during the night of Saturday to Sunday.

stories.title: Des dizaines de personnes meurent lors de deux fusillades en Afrique du Sud

en.title: Dozens of people die in two shootings in South Africa
en.summary: Two shootings at nightlife venues in Cape Town and Johannesburg resulted in a total of 27 deaths overnight Saturday to Sunday, according to police reports.

stories.title: En direct – Vers un large refus des initiatives sur la neutralité et la souveraineté alimentaire

en.title: Live - Towards a broad rejection of initiatives on neutrality and food sovereignty
en.summary: Polling indicates approximately 70 percent rejection of a constitutional neutrality proposal and 73 percent rejection of a food sovereignty initiative, with no canton expected to support either measure.

stories.title: Après les polémiques, le succès très tranquille de l'équipe de Suisse en Macédoine du Nord

en.title: After controversies, Switzerland's team enjoys smooth success in North Macedonia
en.summary: Switzerland's football team defeated North Macedonia 3-0 in their Nations League opener despite missing four regular players and controversy surrounding false COVID certificates. The team topped their group in League B.

stories.title: Ligue des nations - La Suisse fait le job en Macédoine du Nord notamment grâce à un excellent Zeki Amdouni

en.title: Nations League - Switzerland does the job in North Macedonia notably thanks to an excellent Zeki Amdouni
en.summary: Switzerland started their Nations League campaign with a 3-0 victory over North Macedonia in Skopje. Striker Zeki Amdouni scored twice and provided an assist in the convincing performance.

stories.title: Plusieurs milliers de personnes manifestent à Berne en faveur de l’asile et des migrants

en.title: Several thousand people demonstrate in Bern in favor of asylum and migrants
en.summary: Thousands of people protested in Bern organized by asylum and migration advocates, opposing stricter asylum legislation and opposing measures affecting non-Swiss passport holders. The demonstration targeted the federal asylum strategy for 2027 and a UDC border protection initiative.

stories.title: Des milliers de personnes ont manifesté à Berne pour l'asile et les migrants

en.title: Thousands of people demonstrated in Berne for asylum and migrants
en.summary: Several thousand people rallied in Berne on Saturday to protest the tightening of asylum legislation and the exclusion of non-Swiss passport holders from certain protections.

stories.title: On gewinnt die internationalen Investoren für sich, vergrault aber die Schweizer Politiker

en.title: On wins over international investors but alienates Swiss politicians
en.summary: The Zurich sports brand experiences volatile fortunes as its premium strategy attracts investors, yet the Swiss cross symbol it depends on faces renewed political pressure.

stories.title: Die Schweizer Bildungslücke schrumpft – doch aus dem falschen Grund

en.title: Switzerland's education gap shrinks – but for the wrong reasons
en.summary: According to Pisa studies, educational outcomes between privileged and disadvantaged students are converging, though this apparent progress toward equal opportunity masks underlying concerns.

stories.title: «Dieses Mal ist es anders»: Warum der Anlagechef von Lombard Odier bei KI keine Blase sieht

en.title: "This time is different": Why Lombard Odier's investment chief sees no AI bubble
en.summary: Michael Strobaek argues that major technology companies' substantial AI investments are justified, despite preferring other stocks for his portfolio.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - Der arbeitslose Swissair-Pilot von Rio 25 Jahre nach dem Grounding: «Es war eine leichte Befehlsverweigerung, was wir gemacht haben»

en.title: INTERVIEW - The unemployed Swissair pilot from Rio 25 years after the grounding: "It was a slight act of insubordination, what we did"
en.summary: A former Swissair co-pilot who became unemployed when the airline collapsed in 2001 now flies for Swiss and describes differences between the two airlines, particularly that Swiss is operated by a German carrier.

stories.title: Ausgewanderter Schweizer Landwirt: «Ich habe alle meine Ersparnisse nach Argentinien geholt»

en.title: Swiss Farmer Who Emigrated: "I Brought All My Savings to Argentina"
en.summary: Two Swiss farmers transferred their savings to Argentina and supported President Javier Milei's reform course from early on. After two and a half years, they remain convinced of his libertarian policies.
